text: The four year (full time) program provides students with the opportunity to study in areas that are of particular relevance to the business management and conduct of internatinal business ,such as Business Chinese ,China's Economy,World Economy ,Micro-economics,Macro-economies ,Management,Marketing Reseach,International Communication and Busniess Negotiation ,Marketing ,International Trade Practice and Operation ,International Business Law ,International Ecnomic Cooperation ,International Trade Theory and Policy ,National Market and National Ecnomy,International Finance ,Logistics and Port Economy ,International Business Etiquette and China's Investment Envirnment etc. This program is set for those whose native language is not Chinese .Bachelor degree will be conferred to those students have fulfilled the stipulated curriculum ,acquired 120 credits ,and past HSK Band 4. Applicants with IELTS score above 5.0 are eligible.
